hammer.note: at 0.3 the sword won 3 in 4 against it, cutting short 3 in 4 of its blows; at 0.6 (no look-alike slashes left to the sword) the hammer won 2 in 3

evade.note: a roll's or quick move's untouchable part: phases 2-3 of 5 (0.2-0.6). At 0.2 the network did not find it in 4 M steps; widened to 0.1, the roll rose to its top actions, and it went back. A blow touching the body then is evaded (adrenaline). A blow may be dropped for an evade in its first fifth (its wind-up, phase 1)

rules.note: bare-handed: 13 damage, 0.5 s stagger, all its actions 1.4 times as fast (at 1 it won a fifth of its fights, at 1.2 a tenth)
